adm_06.reason: Owner decision (Oct 13, 2026): this race family is admitted on its clean, fixed and planted copies only (ADM-02 to ADM-05). A partial or stub fix of a lost-update race on one at-most-once check has no meaningful in-between form: any change that keeps two concurrent requests from both spending the code is a full fix, so partial and stub probes would be artificial. ADM-06 is recorded as not applicable for this family.

fixed_reference.note: Restoring the used: false guard on the planted file gives bytes identical to the clean file.

invalid_outcomes.note: A probe copy that ends in any of these outcomes is an invalid run, never an effective negative probe.

probes.description: Clean to planted: line 97 drops used: false from the backup-code updateMany, so two concurrent requests can both spend one code.

scope: Each probe changes only the target file's source, never tests or configuration.
